threshold.quote: AI systems with the ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds (e.g., undergraduate STEM degrees) create/obtain and deploy chemical and/or biological weapons with serious potential for catastrophic damages.
threshold.note: Second threshold for novel chem/bio production on p.7.

response.quote: We will maintain or improve on our ASL-3 protections, which include classifier guards at least as robust as our initial Constitutional Classifiers; access controls for trusted users with exemptions to classifier guards
response.note: Named measures. Novel chem/bio row p.7: 'We will apply protections at least as strong as our ASL-3 protections ... to an expanded set of potential use cases'.

acc_decider.quote: The CEO and RSO will make the ultimate determination regarding the adequacy of the risk assessment and any downstream deployment or development plans.
acc_decider.note: Risk Reports cover each threat model and whether relevant thresholds are crossed (p.12); RSO also approves deployment decisions (p.16).

acc_external.quote: On approximately an annual basis, we will commission a third-party review that assesses whether we adhered to this policy's main procedural commitments.
acc_external.note: Framework-wide external adherence review; applies to every risk with a threshold or response.

acc_unmet.quote: When we receive a report, we will promptly investigate, take appropriate and proportional corrective action if it is substantiated, and document the report and our findings.
acc_unmet.note: Framework-wide non-compliance procedure (investigated, documented; quarterly updates to the Board in the next sentence). 'appropriate and proportional' qualifies only the corrective action, not the investigation.

threshold.quote: We will consider this threshold to be met if we determine that either (1) our models would be able to fully substitute for our entire set of Research Scientists and Research Engineers, at competitive costs (i.e., within a factor of 5)

response.quote: We will require a strong argument that catastrophic risk is contained, along the lines of our recommendations for industry-wide safety (see Section 1). We will delay AI development and deployment as needed to achieve this, until and unless we no longer believe we have a significant lead.
response.note: Appendix A; 'highly capable' = crosses the automated AI R&D threshold (p.14). Commitment is competitor-contingent and carries 'as needed'. Section 1 middle column (pp.8-10) commits with 'We will:' to logging/monitoring ('eyes on everything'), alignment assessments, red-teaming and externally reviewed Risk Reports, which are mostly evaluation/monitoring.

acc_decider.quote: The CEO and RSO will make the ultimate determination regarding the adequacy of the risk assessment and any downstream deployment or development plans.
acc_decider.note: Risk Reports cover each threat model and whether relevant thresholds are crossed (p.12); RSO also approves deployment decisions (p.16).

acc_external.quote: Publish Risk Reports with the status of, and noteworthy findings from, all of the above, subject to external review by at least one expert, experienced, credible, candid and disinterested external party.
acc_external.note: Under 'We will:' in the AI R&D row; also p.14 full external review for highly capable models when significantly redacted, and p.16 annual third-party adherence review.

acc_unmet.quote: When we receive a report, we will promptly investigate, take appropriate and proportional corrective action if it is substantiated, and document the report and our findings.
acc_unmet.note: Non-compliance procedure. Appendix A p.17 also: 'Until we are able to do so, we will delay AI development and deployment as needed to achieve this.'
